name: people
description: A person (nfdi:NFDI_0000004) carries identity and label while given name, family name and ORCID identifier are separate value-node individuals reached by obo:IAO_0000235. Involvement in a task area or project is modelled with obo:RO_0000056 (participates in) rather than a direct affiliation literal.
competency_questions: Which researchers are involved in NFDI-MatWerk, and in which task area?; What is the ORCID iD of a given researcher, and which organisation are they affiliated with?; Which academic disciplines does a researcher work in?; Which datasets, software or publications is a given researcher a creator of?
